earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: Revenue: $5.83 billion, increased 83% compared to $3.19 billion for the third quarter of 2025 (Q3 2025).
GAAP earnings per share 2 (EPS): $3.26, compared to $2.31 for Q3 2025.
Adjusted EPS 2 (non-GAAP)*: $3.30, compared to $1.58 for Q3 2025.
GAAP earnings from operations as a % of revenue: 7.9%, compared to 10.2% for Q3 2025.

quotes.text: Celestica’s strong momentum continued in the third quarter, achieving revenue of $5.83 billion and adjusted EPS (non-GAAP)* of $3.30, up 83% and 109%, respectively.
quotes.by: Rob Mionis, Chair of the Board and CEO of Celestica

outlook: (1) Q4 2026 guidance excludes a negative $0.21 to $0.27 per share (pre-tax) aggregate impact on net earnings on a GAAP basis for employee stock-based compensation (SBC) expense, amortization of intangible assets (excluding computer software), and restructuring charges.
Q4 2026 guidance assumes an adjusted effective tax rate (non-GAAP)* of approximately 20%.

items.heading: We are dependent on a limited number of customers and end markets and are sensitive to their investment cycles and operating conditions. Revenue decline or loss of any major customer could have a material adverse effect on our operating results, financial position and cash flows.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations

items.heading: The future development and adoption of AI and the deployment of data center infrastructure are uncertain and depend on the availability and cost of critical inputs (including power and water), which could materially affect demand for our products and services and our operating results.
Our revenue and operating results may vary significantly from period to period.

Inherent challenges in managing changes in customer demand has and may continue to impact our planning, supply chain execution and manufacturing, and may adversely affect our operating performance and results.

Adoption, integration and use of AI in manufacturing and service offerings and in certain of our internal processes may present regulatory, ethical, data and cybersecurity risks and result in reputational harm or liabilities.

We are dependent on third parties to supply certain materials, and our results were negatively affected by the availability of such materials in the past and may be negatively affected by the quality, availability and cost of such materials in the future.
